dataset_metadata.name: ISL Alphabet & Fingerspelling Dataset Specification
dataset_metadata.reference: Indian Sign Language (ISL) Alphabet Dataset on Kaggle (prathumarikeri/indian-sign-language-isl)
dataset_metadata.scope: Isolated manual alphabet letters (A-Z) and digits (1-9) for fingerspelling, not general continuous sentence translation.
dataset_metadata.signing_nature: Static manual configurations primarily utilizing two-handed fingerspelling conventions characteristic of ISL.

A.description: Dominant index finger touching the tip of the non-dominant thumb.

B.description: Both hands form circles with thumbs and index fingers touching to create a 'B' shape.

C.description: Dominant hand forms a curved 'C' shape facing sideways.

D.description: Non-dominant index finger held vertically upright while dominant index finger and thumb form a curve against it.

E.description: Dominant index finger touching the tip of the non-dominant index finger.

F.description: Dominant index and middle fingers placed horizontally across non-dominant index and middle fingers.

G.description: Both closed fists placed one on top of the other.

H.description: Dominant open palm sliding horizontally across non-dominant open flat palm.

I.description: Dominant index finger touching the tip of the non-dominant middle finger.

J.description: Dominant index finger starts on the non-dominant middle finger and traces down into palm in a 'J' curve.

K.description: Non-dominant index finger held vertical; dominant hooked index finger touching its joint.

L.description: Dominant thumb and index finger extended at right angles forming an 'L' shape.

M.description: Three middle fingertips of dominant hand resting on non-dominant flat palm.

N.description: Two fingertips (index and middle) of dominant hand resting on non-dominant flat palm.

O.description: Dominant index finger touching the tip of the non-dominant ring finger.

P.description: Dominant index finger and thumb forming a circle, touching the tip of the non-dominant upright index finger.

Q.description: Non-dominant thumb and index form a circle; dominant index finger hooks through it.

R.description: Dominant hooked index finger resting across non-dominant upright palm.

S.description: Little fingers of both hands hooked together.

T.description: Dominant index finger touching the side/edge of non-dominant flat hand.

U.description: Dominant index finger touching the tip of non-dominant little finger.

V.description: Dominant index and middle fingers extended in 'V' shape resting on non-dominant palm.

W.description: Both hands interlock fingers pointing upwards in 'W' shape.

X.description: Index fingers of both hands crossed over each other forming an 'X'.

Y.description: Dominant hand index finger resting in the 'V' between thumb and index of non-dominant hand.

Z.description: Dominant hand held in vertical flat palm against non-dominant palm forming bent 'Z' plane.
